# Qualify a sales opportunity

[Overview](#overview) · [Before you start](#before-you-start) · [Steps](#steps-at-a-glance)

## Overview

When a prospect may become a commercial opportunity. An evidence-based qualification and next-step decision with an owner and recorded customer commitments.

Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.

> This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.

## Step details

<a id="step-1"></a>

### 1. Prepare the account and problem brief

agent-runnable


Collect the prospect's stated problem, organization, existing solution and prior interactions from authorized records. Separate verified customer statements from assumptions and avoid adding unnecessary personal information.

- Sources: [GitLab customer success management handbook](https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/customer-experience/csm/)

<a id="step-2"></a>

### 2. Confirm the need and buying process

human · human approval required


Discuss the desired outcome, decision participants, constraints and purchasing process with the prospect. Record unanswered questions and distinguish a user's interest from authority or budget to buy.

- Sources: [GitLab customer success management handbook](https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/customer-experience/csm/)

<a id="step-3"></a>

### 3. Assess fit and delivery dependencies

agent-runnable


Compare the requested outcome with actual product capability, security needs, support and implementation effort. Flag roadmap promises, regulated uses or custom work that need separate approval.

- Sources: [GitLab customer success management handbook](https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/customer-experience/csm/)

<a id="step-4"></a>

### 4. Choose the next commercial step

human · human approval required


The sales owner decides whether to proceed, nurture, refer or decline. Agree the next customer action and any approved discovery, demonstration or pilot without inventing a close date.

- Sources: [GitLab customer success management handbook](https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/customer-experience/csm/)

<a id="step-5"></a>

### 5. Update the pipeline evidence

agent-runnable


Record the stage, reasoning, value assumptions, owner and next review. Keep proposals and contract commitments in their reviewed processes and close stale opportunities with an explicit reason.

- Verify: An evidence-based qualification and next-step decision with an owner and recorded customer commitments.
- Sources: [GitLab customer success management handbook](https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/customer-experience/csm/)
